description: Delegate SVG icon serialization to the V14 shell icon renderer while keeping the legacy icon registry and exact fallback output inside the locked runtime.

changes.find: function icon(name,size=18){return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${ICON_PATHS[name]||ICON_PATHS.cube}"/></svg>`;}
changes.replace: function icon(name,size=18){const service=globalThis.AtelierV14Shell?.icons;if(service?.render){const rendered=service.render(name,size,ICON_PATHS);if(rendered!==false)return rendered;}return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${ICON_PATHS[name]||ICON_PATHS.cube}"/></svg>`;}
